scenes.title: Beyond Classical Bits
scenes.narration: Quantum computers leverage bizarre quantum mechanics to solve problems classical machines can't, like factoring massive numbers exponentially faster. This could revolutionize fields from medicine to materials science.

scenes.title: The Power of Superposition
scenes.narration: Unlike classical bits, a qubit can exist in a superposition of both 0 and 1 simultaneously, like a spinning coin before it lands. This allows quantum computers to explore many possibilities at once.

scenes.title: Entanglement & Interference
scenes.narration: Entanglement links qubits so their fates are intertwined, even across vast distances, enabling complex calculations. Quantum interference then amplifies correct answers while canceling out incorrect ones.

scenes.title: Simulating Molecules
scenes.narration: Quantum computers can precisely simulate complex molecular interactions, accelerating drug discovery and material science. This allows researchers to design new medicines or advanced materials with unprecedented accuracy.

scenes.title: Unlocking New Frontiers
scenes.narration: Quantum computing promises to solve currently intractable problems, from optimizing global logistics to breaking modern encryption. While still nascent, it's a powerful tool for scientific discovery and technological advancement.
